title: Beyond Vanilla+
description: Minecraft the way it was always meant to be – more adventures, structures, details, and atmosphere, while staying true to its roots.
body:
_Beyond Vanilla_ is an **expanded modpack** that enhances classic Minecraft without turning it upside down. _New biomes_, **hundreds of structures**, _realistic weather effects_, **improved performance**, _enhanced exploration_, and **dozens of details** that bring fresh life to the game. Perfect for players who want to experience **a new level of Minecraft** while _keeping its original spirit_.

Stay True resource pack was taken from this website:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/stay-true
